The majority of Métis people in Canada live in urban areas, primarily within the Prairie provinces and Ontario [d2][d4]. According to 2011 census data, about 85 per cent of self-identified Métis in Canada live in Ontario and the four western provinces, with Alberta having the largest provincial Métis population (96,865), followed by Ontario (86,015) and Manitoba (78,830) [d4]. Winnipeg has the largest Métis urban population in Canada with 46,325 residents, followed by Edmonton with 31,780 [d4]. Most Métis today are descendants of unions between generations of Métis individuals and live in urban areas, with the exception of those in rural and northern parts near First Nations communities [d1][d5].
